releaseNotes: Fixed crash when clicking Import Data on Android devices by adding safe OpenDocument -> GetContent -> Chooser fallbacks.
Moved file reading, parsing, and Room import onto background IO with full exception handling so malformed or large files never close the app.
Upgraded importer to support third-party app CSV/TSV exports (UTF-8/UTF-16 BOM, split Debit/Credit, positive amounts + Type, currency symbols, dates) and JSON backups in both Accounts and Settings.
